subject: BYTE-LENGTH function

It was 'takes 1 argument(s); 2 given' — a two-arm dispatch with one arm fixed (PB24 fixed LENGTH only). The keyword is transparent under the §15.14.4 r7 determination (CONFORMANCE.md). Editions: the argument-1-only format is 2002's (byte_length_below_2002 pins the 85 gate); PHYSICAL belongs to the 2014 variable-length-group family and is not separately edition-gated (the 2002 text is not in the submodule to cite).
